## Highlights

- Bundles `horus` 0.7.1 so remote frontends receive subagent picker and transcript-preview events
  during an active turn.
- Keeps the existing deferred behavior for capability commands that do not opt into active
  handling.

## Upgrade

- Gateway protocol 23, configuration version 14, chat specification version 6, checkpoint version
  5, and SQLite schema 4 are unchanged.
